destination.title: Thermal string phases and emergent cosmology
destination.question: Which thermal string or related emergent phases can supply early-universe backgrounds and fluctuations, and how do their dynamical assumptions, transitions and observable targets differ?
destination.summary: Thermal perturbation production, background evolution, dimensional selection and inflationary histories form related questions. Matrix and topological emergence provide framework comparisons; S-brane bounces provide a vacuum-fluctuation boundary case. Hagedorn response and dark radiation remain distinct applications. Other string-inspired inflationary programmes retain alternate homes.

systems: String-motivated topological and S-brane constructions as comparisons
regimes: Ekpyrotic contraction and bounce as a boundary case
Proposed high-temperature de Sitter and nonequilibrium limits
assumptions: Assumptions are model-specific; no shared dilaton behavior, energy condition, dimension count or fluctuation state is imposed.
Historical and pre-Swampland studies remain eligible.
conventions: Frame, clock and Planck conventions remain source-specific.
includes: Comparative navigation among distinct mechanisms and targets
Description-supported questions whose answers remain unverified
excludes: Canonical equivalence inferred from shared string motivation or approximate scale invariance
Universal nonsingularity inferred from a limiting temperature
Nonthermal moduli, running-vacuum and kinetic-dilaton mechanisms as instances of thermal string-gas production

evidence.text: Can momentum–winding competition create a quasi-static primordial phase and subsequently release three spatial directions to expand?

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: Find regular compact complex saddles for final cosmological data, evaluate their actions, and determine which integration contours include them.

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: Weight field occupancy by physical volume and potential, then integrate over reheating times compatible with the final local data.

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: Treat Gauss–Bonnet separately from nondegenerate curvature polynomials and use the explicit scalar boundary action for convergence tests.

sources.title: Dark radiation and the Hagedorn phase

evidence.text: Can an early open-string Hagedorn phase in the visible sector suppress the dark-radiation contribution to ΔNeff when the dark sector does not participate in that plasma, even for appreciable inflaton branching into dark radiation?

sources.title: Nonsingular Ekpyrotic Cosmology with a Nearly Scale-Invariant Spectrum of Cosmological Perturbations and Gravitational Waves

evidence.text: Can a string-motivated S-brane simultaneously mediate a nonsingular ekpyrotic bounce and convert initially vacuum scalar and tensor fluctuations into nearly scale-invariant spectra?

sources.title: Emergent cosmology from matrix theory

evidence.text: Can thermal matrix theory provide a nonsingular emergent cosmology with three large spatial dimensions, a late radiation era, and scalar and tensor perturbations compatible with cosmological observations?

sources.title: String gas cosmology and structure formation

evidence.text: Can thermal string fluctuations in a quasi-static Hagedorn phase generate causal, adiabatic, nearly scale-invariant primordial perturbations without de Sitter expansion, with a distinctive tensor spectrum?

sources.title: Creating spatial flatness by combining string gas cosmology and power law inflation

evidence.text: Can a primordial string gas generate observable large-scale perturbations while a shorter, later inflationary phase creates spatial flatness? The proposed history separates these tasks through a Hagedorn phase, radiation, inflation, and standard post-inflationary expansion.

sources.title: Waiting for inflation: A new initial state for the Universe

evidence.text: Can a nearly static pre-inflationary lingering phase provide an alternative initial state addressing inflation's past-singularity problem while preserving the NEC, and can Hagedorn string thermodynamics motivate such a phase?

sources.title: Geometric precipices in string cosmology

evidence.text: Can Hagedorn, winding-mode and momentum-mode string gases undergo smooth cosmological transitions once the dynamical dilaton is retained, particularly from a past-regular Hagedorn phase to expanding radiation FRW?

sources.title: Creating spatial flatness by combining string gas cosmology and power law inflation

evidence.text: Can inflation begin sufficiently soon after the Hagedorn phase to avoid recollapse despite its low final scale? The source compares onset and string energies rather than solving the intervening curved radiation evolution.

sources.title: Producing a scale-invariant spectrum of perturbations in a Hagedorn phase of string cosmology

evidence.text: Can thermal fluctuations of a closed-string gas in an early Hagedorn phase generate nearly scale-invariant cosmological perturbations, followed by ordinary radiation domination, without an intervening period of inflation?

sources.title: The Hagedorn Temperature as a Nonequilibrium Dynamical Bottleneck in String Thermodynamics

evidence.text: Under which conditions does the Hagedorn scale become a nonequilibrium dynamical bottleneck, and can its thermodynamic response distinguish emergent-string from decompactification limits?

sources.title: BFSS Matrix Model Cosmology: Progress and Challenges

evidence.text: Can a high-temperature BFSS matrix state provide emergent time, space, a metric and an early-universe cosmology with observationally relevant thermal perturbations?

sources.title: Hagedorn inflation: Open strings on branes can drive inflation

evidence.text: Can the thermal stress of open strings near the Hagedorn temperature initiate inflation on a three-brane without an inflaton potential, and can that expansion persist long enough to address the horizon problem?

sources.title: Fundamental Physics, the Swampland of Effective Field Theory and Early Universe Cosmology

evidence.text: Can primordial fluctuations originate thermally in a long, quasi-static high-density phase rather than from vacuum fluctuations during accelerated expansion?

sources.title: De Sitter quantum breaking, swampland conjectures and thermal strings

evidence.text: How does quantum-breaking censorship change when a de Sitter temperature crosses the string Hagedorn scale? The source compares a low-temperature phase with H < M_s and a proposed high-temperature phase with H > M_s.

sources.title: Topological Gravity as the Early Phase of Our Universe

evidence.text: Can an early topological phase of gravity, motivated by string dualities, explain homogeneous, isotropic, spatially flat initial conditions and nearly scale-invariant primordial fluctuations, while yielding distinctive CMB predictions?

sources.title: Tensor Modes from a Primordial Hagedorn Phase of String Cosmology

evidence.text: Can thermal closed-string fluctuations in a primordial Hagedorn phase generate nearly scale-invariant gravitational waves, with a tensor tilt or amplitude distinguishing this scenario from conventional slow-roll inflation?

sources.title: S-brane to thermal non-singular string cosmology

evidence.text: Can a string cosmology remain for an arbitrarily long early interval at maximal temperature in a Brane regime, then join an expanding thermal Momentum regime through a nonsingular, perturbatively controlled transition?

sources.title: On three dimensions as the preferred dimensionality of space via the Brandenberger-Vafa mechanism

evidence.text: Can successive thermal fluctuations make three spatial dimensions the preferred outcome of the Brandenberger–Vafa mechanism, rather than merely its maximum, after an initial fluctuation unwinds and expands one or two dimensions?

destination.title: String cosmological dynamics and their limits
destination.question: How do string degrees of freedom, dilaton dynamics, dualities and corrections shape cosmological evolution, and under which assumptions are the resulting histories consistent and controlled?
destination.summary: A broad family connecting cosmological actions, accelerating solutions, matter evolution, stabilization, observable couplings and nonsingular histories. Its numerical membership requires differentiated scopes rather than a universal de Sitter or Swampland interpretation.

systems: String and dilaton cosmologies, including matter-coupled and vacuum backgrounds
Rolling scalar models and string compactification proposals
Adjacent brane, multistring, doubled-space and functional-RG constructions
targets: Dilaton capture, decoupling and thermal stability
Bounces, pre-big-bang evolution and cyclic histories
Matter relics, perturbations and observational consistency
regimes: Source-specific dimensions, spatial curvature and symmetry restrictions
Tree-level, perturbatively corrected and all-order α′ treatments kept distinct
Early-universe, late-time and asymptotic questions kept distinct
assumptions: Control and string embedding are often targets rather than established premises

Alternative frameworks enter through explicitly qualified neighboring scopes
conventions: String-frame and Einstein-frame expansion are distinct
Physical, generalized and shifted dilatons are not identified without a supplied dictionary

Restricted no-go arguments and proposed routes beyond their assumptions

Equating all α′ orders with inclusion of string loops or full quantum control

sources.title: The Dilaton and Modified Gravity

evidence.text: Can a strong-coupling string dilaton with an exponential runaway potential and a finite-field minimum of its matter coupling provide dark energy, evade local gravity tests, and still modify cosmological structure formation?

sources.title: No Open or Flat Bouncing Cosmologies in Einstein Gravity

evidence.text: Does the string-worldsheet origin of Ricci convergence prohibit open or flat FRW bounces in Einstein gravity, and which approximations or geometric assumptions leave possible routes around that prohibition?

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Does the failure of controlled tree-level de Sitter constructions justify a statement about full quantum string theory? The source considers quantum corrections a plausible necessary ingredient, while acknowledging that localized sources already encode some nonperturbative effects.

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Do heterotic de Sitter no-go results transfer to positive-cosmological-constant type IIB backgrounds through string dualities? The paper identifies preservation of spacetime character and correction of the duality rules as unresolved requirements.

sources.title: Swampland conjecture in $f(R)$ gravity by the Noether Symmetry Approach

evidence.text: Which string-cosmological symmetry motivates selecting modified-gravity models? The paper uses inversion of the scale factor with a compensating dilaton shift in a low-energy graviton–dilaton theory.

sources.title: Duality invariant cosmology to all orders in $\alpha$'

evidence.text: What is the most general duality-invariant cosmological action for the metric, b-field and dilaton to all orders in α′, and what perturbative and non-perturbative FLRW solutions does its theory space permit?

sources.title: O$(d,d)$ covariant string cosmology to all orders in $\alpha^{\prime}$

evidence.text: How can matter be coupled to homogeneous string backgrounds while retaining manifest O(d,d) covariance to all orders in α', and what conditions then permit constant-dilaton or de Sitter cosmologies?

sources.title: String tension between de Sitter vacua and curvature corrections

evidence.text: Do all-order string curvature corrections permit de Sitter expansion when string loops can be neglected? The paper addresses this through symmetry-restricted cosmological effective actions rather than through a general compactification or a fully unrestricted gravitational functional integral.

sources.title: Cosmology at the top of the α′ tower

evidence.text: How does matter couple consistently to duality-invariant, all-order α′ cosmology, and under what conditions can the correction tower support Einstein-frame acceleration or nonsingular bounces?

sources.title: Cosmic acceleration from string induced Galileons

evidence.text: Which accelerating cosmological solutions arise from string-induced Horndeski gravity, how do they depend on frame and dimensionality, and can their scalar and tensor perturbations be stabilized?

sources.title: An <math display="inline"><msup><mi>α</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></math>-complete theory of cosmology and its tensionless limit

evidence.text: Can cosmologically reduced HSZ theory provide an exactly duality invariant model retaining all α′ corrections, determine the cosmological coefficients through α′⁴, and admit a useful tensionless limit?

sources.title: Stability of the de-Sitter spacetime. The anisotropic case

evidence.text: How do anisotropic perturbations affect the stability of isotropic de Sitter solutions in cosmological string effective equations with α′ corrections, and can changes of the shifted-dilaton branch support a pre-big-bang scenario?

evidence.text: Under what conditions do homogeneous O(d,d)-invariant vacuum cosmologies admit de Sitter metrics in string and Einstein frames, how stable are they, and do the existence conditions survive embedding in a Bianchi I theory?

sources.title: Cosmological Chameleons, string theory and the swampland

evidence.text: Can homogeneous populations of states whose masses grow along a modulus direction temporarily stabilize an otherwise steep runaway, produce cosmological acceleration compatible with swampland expectations, and admit a controlled string embedding?

sources.title: Instant cosmology

evidence.text: How do NEC-violating instant folded strings (IFSs) modify homogeneous cosmology, and can their backreaction support accelerated expansion, effective dilaton stabilization, modified matter gravity and cosmological bounces?

sources.title: Dark energy in perturbative string cosmology

evidence.text: Can weakly coupled string cosmology support eternal acceleration and a gauge-invariant scattering description, and can scattering in a runaway-modulus background probe stabilized de Sitter or isolated Minkowski vacua?

sources.title: The Pre - big bang scenario in string cosmology

evidence.text: Can kinetic-dilaton inflation before the hot big bang provide a string-motivated cosmology, and which predictions survive uncertainty about the nonperturbative transition?

sources.title: String Theory and Pre-big bang Cosmology

evidence.text: Can string duality and dilaton dynamics produce inflation from a weakly coupled, low-curvature past, permit a nonsingular transition to standard cosmology, and generate distinctive scalar and tensor spectra?

sources.title: Pre - big bang in string cosmology

evidence.text: Can string dualities motivate an accelerated, growing-curvature phase preceding standard cosmology, replace the initial singularity, supply sufficient inflation, and leave observable relic gravitons?

sources.title: The Dilaton and Modified Gravity

evidence.text: Evolve separate Fourier-space linear perturbations for galaxies and pressureless matter, then calculate galaxy growth, weak-lensing and ISW response parameters, and EG.

sources.title: No Open or Flat Bouncing Cosmologies in Einstein Gravity

evidence.text: A background-field expansion X=X_0+Y uses Riemann normal coordinates around the classical embedding. Integrating fluctuations at one worldsheet loop introduces curvature counterterms in the effective action.

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Replace explicit critical-point field values by potential energies, solve the resulting linear constraints, and optimize the normalized smallest Hessian eigenvalue subject to signs. The procedure yields sufficient instability bounds without finding individual vacua, provided the scaling truncation and scalar normalization are valid.

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Specify the kinetic metric, compute the directional derivative, apply the dual-norm inequality, and divide by the displacement norm. This transfers a premise rather than generating a universal positive constant.

sources.title: Swampland conjecture in $f(R)$ gravity by the Noether Symmetry Approach

evidence.text: Reduce the covariant theory to FRW minisuperspace, vary a and R, and impose the energy constraint. The paper fixes cosmic-time lapse before its classical symmetry analysis.

sources.title: Duality invariant cosmology to all orders in $\alpha$'

evidence.text: An order-by-order induction uses integration by parts, S²=1 and trace identities, together with duality-covariant redefinitions of S, Φ and the lapse. Higher time derivatives and dilaton derivatives are eliminated from corrections; lapse redefinitions additionally remove factors tr((DS)²). Integer partitions count the remaining structures.

sources.title: De Sitter Space and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does a positive quantum-generated term in a string model produce a de Sitter minimum once the dilaton is treated dynamically?

sources.title: Dilaton destabilization at high temperature

evidence.text: Can thermal gauge interactions destroy the metastable dilaton minimum, and what critical temperature and cosmological temperature bounds follow for nonperturbative stabilization?

sources.title: Runaway dilaton and equivalence principle violations

evidence.text: Can cosmological attraction toward infinite bare string coupling suppress a massless dilaton's interactions while leaving observable violations of free-fall universality or variations of constants, quantitatively related to inflationary density fluctuations?

sources.title: Swampland Conjectures and Late-Time Cosmology

evidence.text: Can controlled string constructions produce metastable de Sitter space, or should late-time acceleration instead arise from evolving dark energy?

sources.title: de Sitter, $\alpha'$-Corrections & Duality Invariant Cosmology

evidence.text: What restrictions must an all-order α′, duality-covariant cosmological action satisfy to admit Einstein-frame de Sitter expansion, and what changes when the physical dilaton is held constant?

sources.title: New solutions with accelerated expansion in string theory

evidence.text: Can a small set of string-theoretic stress-energy sources produce explicit accelerating FRW solutions with rolling moduli, discrete equations of state, and tractable perturbative control, without first embedding acceleration into separate moduli stabilization?

sources.title: String Regge trajectory in de Sitter space and implications for inflation

evidence.text: Can curvature modify semiclassical string Regge trajectories in de Sitter space enough to respect the Higuchi bound, while retaining the higher-spin states needed for weakly coupled gravitational UV completion? What conditional restrictions on inflation follow?

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: Does pressureless string-gas loitering have finite past action when the dilaton measure is retained?

sources.title: Accelerated expansion of an open universe and string theory realizations

evidence.text: Can negatively curved FLRW cosmologies sustain accelerated expansion with steep positive exponential potentials compatible with proposed string asymptotic slope bounds, and can such solutions arise in controlled string settings?

sources.title: A Cosmological mechanism for stabilizing moduli

evidence.text: Can generic dilaton couplings to matter kinetic or thermal energy prevent overshoot of a steep nonperturbative potential and cosmologically guide the field into its desired local minimum over a broad range of initial conditions?

sources.title: String Cosmology

evidence.text: These lectures review how string theory might accommodate a small cosmological constant and inflation, emphasizing moduli stabilization, obstacles to flat inflaton potentials, possible remedies, and observational signatures.

sources.title: Stabilizing the dilaton in superstring cosmology

evidence.text: Can expansion driven by other matter prevent dilaton overshoot, allowing initially strong-coupling fields to enter quasi-scaling and settle in gaugino-condensation minima?

sources.title: Instant folded strings, dark energy and a cyclic bouncing universe

evidence.text: Can dilaton gravity, an enhanced symmetry point (ESP), and instant folded strings (IFSs) support a repeating, nonsingular cosmological background with reheating, transient dark energy, and slow contraction while remaining perturbatively controlled?

sources.title: Dilaton, winding modes and cosmological solutions

evidence.text: How does a dynamical dilaton change homogeneous cosmological evolution with duality-symmetric momentum and winding sources, especially expansion bounds, turning points, and possible approach to a self-dual radius?

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: Can α-attractor kinetic structure arise in an asymptotic region of string moduli space?

sources.title: On Cosmological Constants from alpha'-Corrections

evidence.text: Can perturbative α′ corrections alone generate a small nonzero cosmological constant in controlled heterotic compactifications at string tree level, once higher external-curvature terms beyond an effective scalar potential are retained?

sources.title: Accelerating cosmologies and inflation from M/superstring theories

evidence.text: Which assumptions behind supergravity de Sitter no-go results can be relaxed to obtain accelerating cosmologies or sufficient early inflation from M/string theory, particularly through evolving compact dimensions and higher-curvature corrections?

sources.title: Spontaneous dark-matter mass generation along cosmological attractors in string theory

evidence.text: Can cosmological attractors in finite-temperature string theory trigger a modulus transition that makes initially relativistic particles heavy, allowing a surviving non-relativistic dark-matter relic?

sources.title: No accelerating scaling cosmologies at string tree level?

evidence.text: Can parametrically controlled string tree-level compactifications support perturbatively stable, eternally accelerating scaling cosmologies, or do their exponential potentials inherit obstacles analogous to the tachyon problem of classical de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Dark Energy in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a string modulus remain light enough to drive present acceleration while avoiding fifth forces and time variation of visible-sector couplings?

sources.title: New non-perturbative de Sitter vacua in $\alpha'$-complete cosmology

evidence.text: Under what conditions do time-dependent, duality-invariant theories with corrections to all orders in α′ admit nonperturbative de Sitter geometries in both string and Einstein frames, including anisotropic metrics and nonzero b-field?

sources.title: The String dilaton and a least coupling principle

evidence.text: Can string-loop corrections and cosmological evolution suppress the observable couplings of a massless dilaton, and what residual deviations from general relativity would remain?

sources.title: Accelerating universe at the end of time

evidence.text: Can spatially flat FLRW cosmologies with multiple canonical scalars and multiple exponential potential terms accelerate asymptotically, and what restrictions follow when a string-theoretic dilaton continues rolling?

sources.title: $\alpha'$-Cosmology: solutions and stability analysis

evidence.text: Which matter-coupled cosmological solutions are allowed by O(d,d)-covariant string equations including all classical α′ corrections, how do they appear in String and Einstein frames, and are they stable under homogeneous linear perturbations?

sources.title: Supercritical String Cosmology drains the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a local metric–dilaton description of non-critical strings support an inflationary positive potential when additional string states fail to decouple? The proposed mechanism uses a time-like Liouville mode to modify cosmological evolution.

sources.title: Elements of string cosmology

evidence.text: How does dynamical dilaton evolution make string cosmology compatible with large–small radius duality, alter winding-mode backreaction, and connect critical-string radiation evolution with noncritical two-dimensional cosmologies?

sources.title: Cosmological stabilization of moduli with steep potentials

evidence.text: Can a cosmological source that redshifts more slowly than modulus kinetic energy prevent overshoot and permit capture in an extremely shallow minimum of a steep string-modulus potential?

sources.title: Stability of the nonperturbative <math display="inline"><mi>O</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>D</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>D</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> de Sitter spacetime: The isotropic case

evidence.text: Are isotropic de Sitter solutions with constant generalized dilaton temporally stable in an O(D,D)-invariant, all-orders-α′ cosmological action? What restrictions does sustained weak coupling impose on a generalized-dilaton potential?

sources.title: String tension between de Sitter vacua and curvature corrections

evidence.text: Can omitted loops or a broader cosmological ansatz admit de Sitter solutions, and can the FRG construction be matched to string perturbation theory in critical dimension? The paper leaves these questions open and also proposes extending the approach to worldsheet Weyl-anomaly cancellation.

sources.title: Non-perturbative de Sitter vacua via $\alpha'$ corrections

evidence.text: Can all higher-derivative corrections compatible with cosmological duality be organized sufficiently to exhibit classical, string-frame de Sitter solutions non-perturbative in α′?

sources.title: Experimental tests of dark bubble cosmology

evidence.text: Can α′² corrections to a nucleated D3-brane's tension produce a positive four-dimensional cosmological constant in dark bubble cosmology, and can its observed value together with α_EM determine experimentally accessible bulk and string scales?

sources.title: String tension between de Sitter vacua and curvature corrections

evidence.text: The retained universe has one isotropic scale factor and a homogeneous dilaton, with no Kalb-Ramond background. This setting tests whether curvature corrections alone can sustain de Sitter expansion while preserving the homogeneous string cosmology assumptions.
